name: One King Down
label: Equal Vision
lede: An Albany straight edge band with a bassist on the Equal Vision payroll, a guitarist who auditioned for the Foo Fighters, and three singers in about three years, whose one great EP still outranks everything they did after it.

eras.title: Albany, before the growl
eras.text: One King Down started in Albany, New York around the Scoville brothers, playing crunchy, danceable metalcore in the mould of Snapcase and Earth Crisis. The first singer made one record and was gone.

years.p: Brothers Bill Scoville (bass) and Mike Scoville (guitar), guitarist Matt Wood and drummer Derrick Van Wie self-release a demo cassette called Jawbreaker in Albany.
One King Down's first CD, cut with an original vocalist Wikipedia doesn't name. He's gone before the band's breakthrough.

eras.title: Bloodlust Revenge
eras.text: Rob Fusco's growl and his loud vegan straight edge politics made One King Down an international name. Not everyone in the band was vegan, but all of them were drug-free, and they had an inside line to Equal Vision: Bill Scoville worked there.

years.h: Rob Fusco becomes One King Down's singer
years.p: Rob Fusco joins One King Down and changes the band. His vegan straight edge message draws attention from well beyond Albany, though the rest of the band never all went vegan.

One King Down's first Equal Vision record, released through the label where bassist Bill Scoville worked. It sold thousands at shows, and Wikipedia calls it still regarded by most fans as the band's finest hour.

years.h: One King Down on the road with Earth Crisis, Madball and Hatebreed
years.p: One King Down support [[Earth Crisis|88a6037e-87ba-492a-a54c-c927aa620cb8]] and [[Madball|c9e0a0f5-9f53-4247-a52d-a3f29d975e17]] and tour with [[Hatebreed|40b7efb7-1268-4a80-b354-600afdcbe9e2]]. A split EP with Spirit of Youth comes out on Good Life Recordings in this era.

eras.title: Singers come and go
eras.text: Internal fights pushed Rob Fusco out right before a national tour. One King Down went through two replacements in a year, then took Fusco back and lost their drummer, finishing as a four-piece before turning down Hellfest in Syracuse and calling it a day.

years.h: Rob Fusco quits One King Down before a national tour
years.p: Internal conflict drives Rob Fusco out just ahead of a national tour. Ryan Downey of Burn It Down fills in for exactly two shows.
years.xp: Downey wasn't a long-term answer. The band looked to Syracuse and found Jon Peters, who sang on the first full-length.

years.p: One King Down's debut full-length on CD and 12", sung by Syracuse's Jon Peters in Rob Fusco's place.
years.xp: Around this time guitarist Mike Scoville auditioned for the [[Foo Fighters|67f66c07-6e61-4026-ade5-7e782fad3a5d]]. The job went to someone else.

years.h: Rob Fusco returns; Derrick Van Wie leaves; Matt Wood moves to drums
years.p: One King Down take Rob Fusco back. Drummer Derrick Van Wie departs, guitarist Matt Wood slides behind the kit, and the band carries on as a four-piece.
One King Down's last Equal Vision release, on 7" and CD.

years.h: Two last One King Down splits, with Mindsnare and Day of Contempt
years.p: One King Down appear on When Angels Shed Their Wings Volume 2 (Devil's Head) and a three-way split 7" with Mindsnare and Day of Contempt (Trial & Error).

years.h: One King Down turn down Syracuse Hellfest and call it quits
years.p: One King Down decline to play Hellfest in Syracuse in 2001 and break up.

eras.title: Rob Loves, Man Kills
eras.text: A shelved demo in 2006, then a proper return in 2018 with the classic line-up, with Rob Fusco back on vocals. The reunion put One King Down back on the bills of the bands they'd once opened for.

years.h: The unreleased Rob Loves, Man Kills demo
years.p: One King Down record a demo whose title rewrites their 1998 album around Rob Fusco. It stays unreleased.

years.h: One King Down return at This Is Hardcore in Philadelphia
years.p: Announced in March, the reunion puts Rob Fusco, the Scoville brothers, Matt Wood and Derrick Van Wie back together at This Is Hardcore.

years.h: A One King Down homecoming at Upstate Concert Hall
years.p: One King Down play the Albany area again at Upstate Concert Hall.

years.h: One King Down on Earth Crisis's Firestorm 30th anniversary tour
years.p: One King Down, who opened for them in the '90s, support [[Earth Crisis|88a6037e-87ba-492a-a54c-c927aa620cb8]] on the Firestorm anniversary run.

years.h: One King Down play For The Children Fest at LA's Belasco
years.p: One King Down play For The Children Fest at the Belasco Theater in Los Angeles.
